description: Step 8: Place a test call. Call `number` from the business's RingKit number and read a 6-digit code twice (valid 10 minutes), to prove the business controls it. The human who answers must tell you the code for ringkit_confirm_destination. A retried identical call returns the same result; pass a new idempotencyKey to place another verification call. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_verify_destination
title: Verify a phone number
